---
title: "Sensor-placement decision"
subtitle: "Primary near-eye analysis with chest-level measurements as a complementary comparison"
---

## Purpose

Apply the approved decision to use near-eye measurements for the main
analysis. Near-eye and chest measurements will not be combined into a single
larger sample.

## What this notebook uses and produces

- Uses: participant-days, meaning one participant's record for one calendar
  day, with measurements from both positions; the separately calculated
  near-eye and chest metrics; and the approved placement decision in
  `audit/decisions/placement_decision.md`.
- Produces: comparisons based on the same participants and days at both
  positions; checks of whether placement differences vary by site or context;
  model checks; estimates in interpretable units with 95% confidence
  intervals; and the exact participants, participant-days, observations, and
  sites used by each model. For every metric, the report also gives the number
  of complete near-eye--chest pairs, paired participants, and paired
  participant-days overall and by site.
- Fixed rule: chest measurements provide a complementary comparison. They are
  not counted as additional independent measurements of near-eye exposure.

```{r}
#| label: setup-placement-decision
#| eval: false

root <- normalizePath(
  Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR"),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)
source(file.path(root, "scripts/pipeline/paths_io.R"))
source(file.path(root, "scripts/pipeline/assertions.R"))

paths <- pipeline_paths(root)
```

The models will account for repeated measurements from the same participant
and participant-day. Near-eye measurement is the reference. Results will show
whether chest measurements differ and whether that difference changes by
metric, site, or context.
